questions.subject: FRENCH
questions.topic: The article with a bread term
questions.learningObjective: Choose the article used with a bread term

stimulus.body: Dans un exercice de français, le professeur demande de choisir la forme qui convient d'après la règle de la leçon.

questions.stem: In a fieldwork record, a specialist reviews the evidence: Quelle réponse applique correctement la règle de la leçon ?

options.text: le pain, definite article not requested
des pain, plural article for singular noun
options.misconception: uses plural for a singular noun

options.text: une pain, wrong gender for pain
un pain, masculine singular article with bread

questions.explanation: Pain is masculine, so the indefinite article is un in a bread phrase. The key is D, "un pain, masculine singular article with bread". Option A ("le pain, definite article not requested") is wrong: uses definite instead of indefinite. Option B ("des pain, plural article for singular noun") is wrong: uses plural for a singular noun. Option C ("une pain, wrong gender for pain") is wrong: assigns feminine gender to pain.
